name: Kaizaki Hiroto
source:
A part-time instructor who was assigned to the academy, replacing a teacher who was hospitalized due to an injury. He teaches Biology and tends to be cooped up in the laboratory during free time. He is very friendly and rarely seen without a smile on his face.

Back when he was student, he took classes held by [url=/c34094]Mai[/url] and [url=/c32637]Nao's[/url] parents.
